in_marathi.name: Jagat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagat refers to the material world, the universe, or the world of experiences. It is derived from the Sanskrit root jag, which means to wander, to be active, to move about.

vedic_reference.note: The name Jagat is derived from the Sanskrit root word jag, which means to be conscious, to awake. In Hindu mythology, Jagat is the name of the material world, created by the god Brahma. It is often used to refer to the entire universe or the physical world.
